rules.title: Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance - Maximum rent increase
rules.requirement: A landlord may raise rent only once each year. The increase cannot be more than 3% of the current rent or 80% of the change in the Consumer Price Index (CPI), whichever is less.
rules.key_value: Lesser of 3% of current rent or 80% of CPI change
rules.coverage_text: Rental units covered by the Santa Ana Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance. The excerpt does not say which buildings are covered.
rules.citation: Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
rules.quoted_span: Your landlord can only raise your rent by a certain amount each year. The increase cannot be more than 3% of your current rent or 80% of the Consumer Price Index (CPI) change, whichever is less.

rules.title: Current Maximum Allowable Rent Increase (September 1, 2026 - August 31, 2027)
rules.requirement: The maximum allowable rent increase is 2.87 percent for the period of September 1, 2026 through August 31, 2027.
rules.coverage_text: Rental units covered by the Santa Ana Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance.
rules.citation: Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
rules.quoted_span: 2.87 percent is the maximum allowable rent increase for the period of September 1, 2026 through August 31, 2027.
rules.effective_date_phrase: for the period of September 1, 2026 through August 31, 2027

rules.title: Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance - Just cause evictions
rules.requirement: A landlord must have a valid reason to evict a tenant. Examples include not paying rent, breaking the lease, or the landlord wanting to move into the property.
rules.coverage_text: Tenants covered by the Santa Ana Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance.
rules.citation: Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
rules.quoted_span: Your landlord must have a valid reason to evict you. This could be for not paying rent, breaking the lease, or if the landlord wants to move into the property themselves.

rules.title: Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance - Relocation assistance
rules.requirement: A landlord who evicts a tenant for certain reasons may have to help pay the tenant's moving costs.
rules.coverage_text: Tenants evicted for certain reasons under the Santa Ana Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance.
rules.citation: Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
rules.quoted_span: If your landlord evicts you for certain reasons, they might have to help pay for your moving costs.
